issues.title: Carrier callbacks are accepted without verifying who sent them
issues.summary: The webhook route sits outside the token guard and checks no signature.
issues.impact: Tracking state can be written by any client that reaches the route.
issues.fix: Verify a per-carrier signature (or use mutual TLS) before the payload is parsed.

issues.title: Tracking events have no uniqueness constraint
issues.summary: Every delivered event is inserted; nothing identifies a repeat.
issues.impact: Redelivered callbacks create duplicate events and skew on-time reporting.
issues.fix: Add a unique key on the carrier's event identity and upsert instead of insert.

issues.title: Label job retries are not idempotent
issues.summary: A retry re-runs the whole job, including parcels that already have a label.
issues.impact: A transient error can lead to paying for a second label for the same parcel.
issues.fix: Skip parcels that already have a label key, and send an idempotency key with each purchase.

issues.title: Rate quotes ask carriers one after another
issues.summary: On a cache miss, each carrier is called in sequence.
issues.impact: Quote latency grows with the number of carriers and the slowest response.
issues.fix: Call carriers concurrently with a per-carrier timeout and return the rates that arrive.

issues.title: Two processes share one analytics file as writer and reader
issues.summary: The worker rebuilds views in the file the API reads reports from.
issues.impact: Report requests during the nightly rebuild fail.
issues.fix: Build into a new file and swap it in atomically, or serve reports from a read-only copy.

issues.title: The deployment guide describes a manual release
issues.summary: The guide's steps predate the tag-driven pipeline.
issues.impact: Operators follow steps the pipeline no longer uses.
issues.fix: Generate the deployment section from the model and remove the manual steps.
